in_marathi.name: Upesh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Upesh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Upa' meaning 'near' and 'Esh' meaning 'god', Upesh signifies 'rising above' and is often given to a child who is expected to excel in all aspects of life. It also symbolizes the child's close connection with the divine.
